label: Bible Study
prompt: Behold, the LORD'S hand is not _____, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:
verse: Behold, the LORD'S hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:
note: Distance from God isn't about his reach — the next verse says it's our sins that make the gap.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But God, who is rich in _____, for his great love wherewith he loved us,
verse: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,
note: Paul's great turnaround words are 'But God' — rich in mercy, and loving us with a great love.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then Abigail made haste, and took two hundred loaves, and two bottles of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of parched corn, and an hundred clusters of _____, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on asses.
verse: Then Abigail made haste, and took two hundred loaves, and two bottles of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of parched corn, and an hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on asses.
note: Abigail's peace offering to David's hungry men: bread, wine, sheep, corn, raisins, and figs — she averted a disaster.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And being found in fashion as a man, he _____ himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.
verse: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.
note: The lowest step of the descent: from the form of God to a servant to a criminal's cross.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Take heed therefore unto yourselves, and to all the flock, over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you _____, to feed the church of God, which he hath purchased with his own blood.
verse: Take heed therefore unto yourselves, and to all the flock, over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers, to feed the church of God, which he hath purchased with his own blood.
note: Paul's farewell charge to the Ephesian elders: feed the flock God 'purchased with his own blood.'
